Tibia has night.

The game features a dynamic day-night cycle, adding a realistic element to the gameplay. During the night, the game world becomes darker, requiring players to utilize various items and spells to provide light for themselves. In Tibia, midnight coincides with the real-life hour.

One interesting aspect of the night in Tibia is the appearance of certain creatures that can only be encountered during this time. For example, inside the Museum of Tibian Arts, statues come to life and pose new challenges for players. Additionally, certain areas on the map, such as Feyrist, undergo transitions between day and night. In Tibia, the night period occurs between 6:00 p.m. and 6:00 a.m., which is equivalent to real-life times of hh:45 and hh:15.

The full day and night cycle in Tibia lasts for approximately one hour in real time. If you would like to learn more about the passage of time in the game, please refer to the Time article for detailed information.

To maintain a fair playing environment, Tibia introduced the Ambient Light slider in the advanced graphical settings. This feature was implemented to counteract any unfair advantage gained through the use of Light Hacks, ensuring a level playing field for all players.

By embracing the night mechanic, Tibia creates an immersive experience for its players, adding depth and strategic elements to their gameplay.
